scene.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake at chest height; A brightly lit orbital market terrace — She catches a rolling orange on her tray at the end of a relaxed market lunch; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing with one foot up on a step; An orbital aquatic center's open sun deck under tall windows — She settles in to watch the sunrise after a swim; a wooden sauna and cold plunge with a cooling lounge — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — coils the cable of a microphone loosely around her hand; a starship galley and mess hall — standing; a small live house with a low stage — perched on a ledge or edge; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — holds a book closed against her chest; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — kneeling on the ground; the grand lobby and staircase of an opera house — tilts a cup; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — hides her smile behind a white feather fan
